releaseNotes: Enhanced Edit Expense with full payer (payee) reassignment, flexible split adjustments (equal and custom unequal allocations), and real-time balance validation.
Redesigned professional PDF export with clean typography, resilient coordinate calculations, multi-page table formatting, and zero layout overlap.
Optimized API auth token refresh with OAuth 2.0 RFC 6819 rotation grace cache, offline network fault tolerance, UUID nonces, and proactive client renewal.
Preserved zero-sum ledger invariants across all expense payer and beneficiary allocation revisions.
